name: cover-tips
description: Navigator skill that routes your rough cover idea to the right style-specific cover skill.

interface.shortDescription: Route your cover idea to the right style-specific cover skill
interface.longDescription: Convert a rough cover idea, product description, article topic, image reference, or design brief into a standardized template or generic image prompt for one of ten cover styles: black-white minimal, trendy color, giant perspective, midnight studio, pixel avatar, Budapest, editorial collage, tea oriental, light product, or McKinsey briefing style.
